description: This is a test class for the LanguageService in the OrangeHRM administrative plugin, specifically testing methods related to language management such as listing, deletion, and retrieval by ID or name.

classes.name: LanguageServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the LanguageService functions related to language management in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of LanguageService and populating test data from a fixture.

methods.name: testGetLanguageList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the language list via the LanguageService, verifying the expected number of language objects is returned.

methods.name: testDeleteLanguages
methods.description: Tests the deletion of languages by IDs through the LanguageService, verifying the correct number of deletions.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a language by its ID and verifies it matches expected data.

methods.name: testGetLanguageByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a language by its name and verifies it matches expected data.
